Expose a permission-checked Record verified reuse action from an eligible receipt/detail record with honest missing-evidence validation.
Verify positive and missing/denied-evidence cases, duplicate verification, corrections and recipient revocation; prepare the unresolved A-6 sample-selection checkpoint.

entries.title: OM-12.02 — Record human-verified useful reuse against task evidence

tasks.text: Implement bounded authorized aggregate queries for distinct Skills/Memory metrics and supported dimensions, using event identity and exact-version links.
Encode period selection, event-time/fallback rules, coverage completeness and zero/partial/unavailable semantics in the statistics contract.
Implement matching authorized drill-down and filter-option queries with current recipient/source/item permissions and revocation invalidation.
Verify replay versus reload counting, multi-item inclusion, late events, unknown attribution, complete/partial windows and permission-safe unique counts.

entries.title: OM-12.03 — Aggregate Skills and Memory measurements without false completeness

tasks.text: Add item/version knowledge statistics to S3/S4 and the separate Skills/Memory section of S7 using the shared metrics contract and equivalent accessible chart/table representations.
Implement receipt/event drill-down and contextual verification flows with stable project/period/version filters and explicit source/recipient disclosure boundaries.
Provide honest empty, partial, unavailable, pending, failure and revoked-access states, including distinctions among delivery, load, use and verified reuse.

Verify the J9 knowledge-measurement journey and FR-11 verification flow with both native clients, keyboard/screen-reader navigation, both themes and phone layouts; keep A-6 acceptance approval pending.

entries.title: OM-12.04 — Inspect knowledge receipts, statistics and reuse evidence

tasks.text: Define S1 query composition and person/project/period filters over the established work-evidence read contracts.
Build the proposed overview layout with summary, attention, progress, work/agent chips, updates and collection coverage components.
Connect each summary/count to its exact permitted detail set and preserve source/time/coverage labels.
Verify own/colleague views, partial outages, source identity ambiguity and permission-filtered drill-down consistency.

entries.title: OM-13.01 — Understand own and colleague work from Daily Work

tasks.text: Define authorized company aggregate queries with per-project coverage and independent disclosure checks.
Build explicit company scope selection, project summaries and safe project drill-down/return navigation.
Add stable basis/coverage labels and contract-level entry points for knowledge and usage capabilities as they become available.
Test inaccessible projects, restricted same-project sources, partial collection and unchanged project-default knowledge scope.

entries.title: OM-13.02 — Compare authorized project context in a company view

Build the separate Focus route and proposed stacked-epic/combined views with persistent project and person context.
Integrate unique-work/run grouping, explicit ungrouped areas and E10 detail/dependency navigation.
Verify simultaneous epics, shared runs, unconfirmed identity, partial mappings and cross-project disclosure boundaries.

entries.title: OM-13.03 — Follow assigned work across concurrent epics

Build six-stage kanban, Stage not mapped area, blocker badges and distinct concurrent-contribution indicators.
Provide phone/keyboard grouped-list parity and links to the same E10 evidence/dependency records.
Verify nonlinear movement, absent/changed mappings, original status preservation, unique counts and revocation during view changes.

entries.title: OM-13.04 — Inspect work through the six observed SDLC stages

tasks.text: Apply shared update-buffering, scope-change and safe-return behavior to S1, company, S2 entry and S10 views.
Add coalesced announcements, accessible paging and route/dialog focus behavior using the foundation components.
Implement immediate protected-content removal and explicit offline/reconnect states without duplicating observation projections.
Run meaningful keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, reduced-motion and revoked-focus scenarios across the completed work views.

entries.title: OM-13.05 — Keep live work views accessible and stable during change

tasks.text: Define canonical usage portions, source precedence, input/output/cache semantics and provenance for each qualified runtime/version.

Implement parent/child and cross-signal overlap handling without adding telemetry sources that describe the same consumption.
Verify cumulative resets, delta duplicates, late windows, missing directions, cache subsets, retries and inaccessible measurements with independent expected totals.

tasks.text: Implement source-backed work/person/context attribution rules and explicit unassigned states using E10 relationship evidence.
Preserve execution segments and distinct configured/requested/observed values in attribution APIs and permitted drill-downs.
Implement correction-aware recomputation and deduplicated epic/project rollups with field-level authorization.
Verify shared sessions/accounts, ambiguous roles, concurrent children, historical machine changes and revoked-field aggregate behavior.

entries.title: OM-14.02 — Attribute usage only to evidenced work and execution segments

tasks.text: Define separate observed-unit, API-equivalent estimate, subscription-allocation and actual-bill records with source/date/currency and access controls.

Implement class-specific aggregation, unpriced/unassigned handling and revision-aware recalculation.
Verify wrong/missing prices, currency mixtures, changed price dates, inaccessible allocation inputs and non-additive measurement classes.

entries.title: OM-14.03 — Keep observed units, estimates, allocations and bills separate

tasks.text: Build authorized S7 breakdown APIs and the chart/table UI with shared query semantics, period/scope retention and explicit measurement classes.
Add ticket/epic usage summaries and run-segment drill-down with model/effort/session/machine provenance and independent In/Out states.
Add accessible loading/error/empty/unsupported/stale behavior and links to separately scoped Skill/Memory statistics.
Verify chart/table parity, phone/keyboard navigation, mixed-class display, hidden-record inference and mid-session revocation against expected calculations.

entries.title: OM-14.04 — Present S7 and contextual work usage with honest coverage

Build a bounded qualification harness for consent/subscription, background arrival and authorized deep-link return using synthetic data.
Record the supported platform matrix, failure limits and a reviewable browser/PWA packaging recommendation, retaining owner approval as a gate.
Validate denied/unsupported/revoked-session behavior and the proposed generic-preview policy before transport implementation.

entries.title: OM-15.01 — Qualify the notification platform and choose supported packaging

tasks.text: Define product notification event kinds, replay identity and explicit preference defaults, separating product changes from raw telemetry packets.
Implement authorized per-person/project/kind preferences and audit emission without coupling them to view filters.
Build S9 consent explanation, permission states, explicit save/error behavior and access-safe event/project selectors.
Verify initial all-update eligibility, opt-outs, failed saves, proposal labeling and revoked-project removal.

tasks.text: Implement the event-to-recipient eligibility projection and atomic notification job creation using the existing PostgreSQL job module.

Persist dispatch attempts and distinct outcomes with retry/backoff, replay deduplication and safe audit/diagnostic metadata.
Test duplicate source events, bursts, changed preferences, revoked/ended sessions, pod restart, transport failure and ambiguous external delivery outcomes.

entries.title: OM-15.03 — Dispatch distinct updates through durable authorized work

tasks.text: Implement notification-reference resolution with current per-target authorization and lifecycle-aware destinations.
Build safe route/focus/return behavior and current-state explanations for resolved, superseded, withdrawn and unavailable targets.
Integrate a scoped updates link without changing notification preferences or exposing hidden event counts.
Verify old alerts, revoked rights, unavailable projects, offline opening and accessible phone/keyboard return flows.

entries.title: OM-15.04 — Open the current authorized state from a notification

Add explicit delayed/unsupported/failed/unknown projections and correction links without rewriting authoritative business history.
Verify producer contract fixtures for all required classes, replay/correction behavior and inference-resistant filtered counts/IDs.

tasks.text: Build S11 filters, bounded activity-list rows, coverage labels and object-history navigation using the existing components.

Apply safe empty/error/offline/revoked states, route focus and scoped return behavior.
Test mobile/keyboard timelines, independently restricted actors/diffs, delayed producers and revocation during expanded history.

entries.title: OM-16.02 — Inspect audit timelines and object changes accessibly

tasks.text: Model Governance-owned versioned collection/retention policies, including backup retention, responsible owners and A-3 live-ingestion gates for source and client paths.
Define and integrate pre-persistence field allowlists/redaction decisions with ingestion, knowledge, audit and diagnostic contracts.

Build authorized policy configuration and audited activation showing 30 active days then archive, no automatic archive purge and preserved project knowledge; keep other record-class and backup policy choices explicit.

Test default-on conversation capture, project opt-out, secret redaction, changed policies during queued work and unauthorized/failed policy saves; distinguish stopping new capture from deleting already retained content.

entries.title: OM-16.03 — Approve collection and retention policy before live ingestion

tasks.text: Define the authorized removal/revocation event and target inventory with separate immediate disclosure denial and asynchronous cleanup outcomes.
Implement idempotent PostgreSQL-backed propagation jobs and per-target adapters/contracts for primary and derived storage.
Add inspectable safe progress/failure/audit records and ensure query/dispatch paths consult current eligibility during cleanup.
Test index/cache/summary/history leakage, interrupted cleanup, duplicate commands, source-authority boundaries and unrecoverable external copies.

entries.title: OM-16.04 — Propagate removal and revocation through derived records

tasks.text: Specify Governance-owned replay ordering/current-policy rules and the shared restore quarantine/reconciliation/release contract consumed by protected reads, dispatch and readiness, including state newer than the selected snapshot.

Implement the single Governance-owned recovery quarantine/release gate and idempotent reconciliation of lifecycle/removal/permission state and effect outcomes via owner APIs; reads and external dispatch consume this gate before resuming. OM-18.02 qualifies this implementation rather than creating a second release authority.
Document governed snapshot retention/expiry and removal-reporting limits alongside the operational restore runbook.
Verify synthetic restore-before-revocation, replay-before-withdrawal, missing policy evidence and incomplete cleanup cases without creating live backup schedules.

entries.title: OM-16.05 — Preserve governance during replay and snapshot recovery

tasks.text: Define the archive contract through the evidence-owning module API: immutable content/version identity, checksum, locator/status, policy version and the 30-day clock for late arrivals and long-running sessions; qualify storage without adding a mandatory separate service.

Implement database-backed idempotent archive jobs with write/verify/publish transitions, integrity/readback checks and safe active-copy release only after a durable archive is reachable; preserve recovery checkpoints and audit outcomes.

Preserve searchable authorized metadata and stable evidence links; implement permission-checked archive read/restore and archived/retrieving/unavailable presentation in existing detail views without treating archival as knowledge approval.

Propagate revocation/removal/policy changes across archive metadata and payloads; cover archive inventory, credentials/configuration references and integrity checks in recovery procedures without promising unsupported snapshot erasure.

Verify the 30-day boundary, late data, duplicate jobs, failed/corrupt archive writes, crash between verification and locator publication, retrieval denial and restore; assert project knowledge and its evidence links survive archiving and no age-only archive purge occurs.

entries.title: OM-16.06 — Archive conversations after 30 days without losing knowledge

Resolve A-5 and set source cadence/stale thresholds and measured latency/setup budgets before the acceptance run; publish limitations.

tasks.text: Choose snapshot support, consistency procedure, failure coverage and recovery targets with the operator; implement and qualify the backup-retention policy owned by OM-16.03 before relying on live backups.

Document and test restore into an isolated synthetic environment including database WAL, archived conversation payloads with their metadata/evidence links and separately stored artifacts; preserve encryption/secret references and consume and qualify the single Governance-owned OM-16.05 recovery quarantine/reconciliation/release gate before reads or external effects resume; do not implement a competing readiness/release authority.

Run bounded receiver saturation, partial acceptance, late/duplicate input, pod termination and stale-lease recovery; restore snapshots preceding revocation, withdrawal and a sent notification to verify fail-closed reconciliation and safe effect replay.
Publish measured RPO/RTO and native telemetry loss limits; propose an optional persistent collector only if measured requirements justify it, without deploying one automatically.

entries.title: OM-18.02 — Restore the installation and survive processing failures

tasks.text: Verify adopted A-1 client-driven validated-default/explicit-candidate behavior at knowledge-quality acceptance; verify adopted A-2 derivative withdrawal/lineage and A-4 disabled-mode behavior before live promotion, resolve A-6 before sample selection, and name permitted-use/maintainer authorities.

Run all named UX journeys and accessibility/device checks against separately packaged frontend/backend artifacts; reuse Testcontainers dependencies for synthetic integration cases, distinguish those from actual live proofs and obtain recorded owner acceptance.
